scientific.integrity: The proof reduces the strong defensive inequalities to exact side-count thresholds in the regular crown graph, treats induced connectivity separately, and counts the disjoint-index boundary cases. Known complete-bipartite formulas are used only as comparison, not as proof of the matching-deleted case.
limitations: The theorem is stated for crown graphs with n at least 4; the n=3 graph is the cycle C6 and has a separate connectivity boundary.
The exact checker exhausts n=4 through n=8 and is corroborative rather than the infinite proof.
Targeted literature searches do not exclude differently indexed older alliance results.

title: Strong alliance polynomial of crown graphs
